nodes.label: Graphify CHANGELOG
nodes.rationale: Running release history of the graphifyy package, documenting features, fixes, and security hardening per version.

nodes.label: graphify extract
nodes.rationale: Headless full-pipeline extraction for CI so AST + semantic extraction can run without Claude Code in the loop; backend resolution deferred until after file detection so code-only corpora run fully offline with no API key.

nodes.label: graphify update
nodes.rationale: Made idempotent — graph.json and GRAPH_REPORT.md only rewritten when content actually changes, to eliminate residual community-count drift.

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.rationale: Seed selection uses IDF weighting and dynamic seed count so a rare identifier outranks common terms and BFS expands from the right node.

nodes.label: graphify label
nodes.rationale: Community labeling was previously an agent-only skill step, so bare-CLI runs never got semantic names; the subcommand regenerates names on demand.

nodes.label: graphify uninstall
nodes.rationale: Single command to remove skill files from all platforms rather than per-platform cleanup.

nodes.label: graphify hook install
nodes.rationale: Embeds sys.executable into generated hook scripts because uv tool and pipx installs silently no-oped where ~/.local/bin is not on PATH.

nodes.label: graphify provider add/list/show/remove
nodes.rationale: Custom LLM provider registry lets any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (NVIDIA NIM, vLLM, OpenRouter, Together, LiteLLM) be registered without a code change.

nodes.label: graphify prs
nodes.rationale: Graph-aware PR dashboard showing CI state, review decision, worktree mapping, and graph blast radius per PR.

nodes.label: graphify global add/remove/list/path
nodes.rationale: Cross-project global graph uses <repo>::<id> prefixed node IDs to prevent silent collisions between projects sharing entity names.

nodes.label: graphify merge-driver
nodes.rationale: Union-merges two graph.json variants and always exits 0 so a git merge is never blocked by conflict markers in the knowledge graph.

nodes.label: graphify tree
nodes.rationale: Self-contained D3 v7 collapsible-tree HTML view of graph.json, XSS-safe via html.escape() and _js_safe().

nodes.label: graphify hook-check
nodes.rationale: Shell-agnostic subcommand replacing inline python3 -c hook commands that failed on Windows Conda and broke PowerShell JSON parsing.

nodes.label: graph.json
nodes.rationale: Made byte-for-byte deterministic across runs — edges sorted by (source, target, relation) and PYTHONHASHSEED=0 exported so diffs stay clean in multi-dev repos.

nodes.label: manifest.json
nodes.rationale: Stores content hash alongside mtime so a sync-tool mtime bump triggers an MD5 check rather than a full re-extraction.

nodes.label: .graphify_labels.json
nodes.rationale: Persists human-readable community labels so they survive re-clustering instead of resetting to generic Community N names.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Follows gitignore semantics — outer rules loaded first so inner rules win via last-match-wins, and discovery is hermetic to the scan folder without a VCS root.

nodes.label: .graphifyinclude
nodes.rationale: Hidden-path allowlist so specific hidden dirs can be opted into traversal.

nodes.label: ~/.graphify/providers.json
nodes.rationale: Project-local ./.graphify/providers.json is no longer auto-loaded because a custom provider's base_url is where the corpus and API key are sent; only the user's own home-directory file is trusted.

nodes.label: detect()
nodes.rationale: Sorts file traversal lexicographically because os.walk order is filesystem-dependent, which made first-writer-wins node-ID decisions and Leiden community counts vary between identical runs.

nodes.label: detect_incremental()
nodes.rationale: Forwards follow_symlinks to detect() so --update runs do not silently miss files reached through a symlinked sub-tree.

nodes.label: collect_files()
nodes.rationale: Extension set auto-syncs with _DISPATCH so newly supported extensions cannot be silently skipped in skill-mode extraction.

nodes.label: _SKIP_DIRS
nodes.rationale: Generated artefact dirs (coverage/, storybook-static/, __snapshots__/, etc.) excluded so they no longer appear in the corpus.

nodes.label: _is_sensitive
nodes.rationale: Checks parent directories against a _SENSITIVE_DIRS blocklist so any file inside .ssh/.aws/secrets is skipped regardless of name; word-boundary bug meant underscore-prefixed secret filenames never matched.

nodes.label: build_from_json()
nodes.rationale: Accepts a root param and relativizes paths at build time so absolute source_file paths from semantic subagents are never stored in the graph.

nodes.label: build_merge()
nodes.rationale: Reads saved JSON directly instead of round-tripping through NetworkX node_link_graph(), which silently reversed edge direction on reload.

nodes.label: edge_data()/edge_datas()
nodes.rationale: Helpers that handle both simple and multi-graphs so explain/path no longer crash on MultiGraph inputs.

nodes.label: find_import_cycles(G)
nodes.rationale: Collapses the symbol graph to a file-level directed import graph and finds simple cycles via Johnson's algorithm, deduplicating rotations before rendering the Import Cycles section.

nodes.label: cohesion_score
nodes.rationale: Returns a raw float with rounding deferred to display, because rounding at source made the cohesion split threshold unreachable.

nodes.label: query_graph MCP tool
nodes.rationale: Truncation message tells the agent what to do next (call get_node or add a context_filter) rather than just reporting truncation.

nodes.label: _score_nodes
nodes.rationale: Three-tier precedence (exact 1000 / prefix 100 / substring 1) instead of flat substring scoring, so distinct labels that substring-match the same node resolve differently.

nodes.label: sanitize_label
nodes.rationale: Applied to all LLM-derived fields as a hardening measure; returns empty string early on None to avoid TypeError.

nodes.label: file_hash
nodes.rationale: Content-only (path removed) so renamed files reuse their cache entry; stat-based mtime fastpath skips the full SHA256 read when size+mtime_ns are unchanged, the same trade-off as make.

nodes.label: save_manifest()
nodes.rationale: Seeds from the existing manifest before the loop and accepts a kind parameter (ast/semantic/both) so incremental AST-only runs do not erase untouched files or overwrite semantic_hash entries.

nodes.label: check_semantic_cache
nodes.rationale: Applies the same absolute-path normalization as save_semantic_cache so relative source_file paths resolve consistently on both sides.

nodes.label: deduplicate_entities
nodes.rationale: Entropy gate + MinHash/LSH blocking + Jaro-Winkler verification + same-community boost collapses near-duplicates before clustering; raises ValueError on cross-repo node sets because cross-project dedup is disabled by design.

nodes.label: Dedup Pass 1 (exact label)
nodes.rationale: Partitions same-label groups by source_file before merging so generic labels like handle/init/run from different files do not collapse into artificial god nodes; cross-file matches route to Pass 2 fuzzy.

nodes.label: Dedup Pass 2 (fuzzy)
nodes.rationale: Same-file partition enforced for the identical-label subcase, and Jaro-Winkler prefix bonus gated by _is_variant_pair/_short_label_blocked so chip/model SKU variants are not false-merged while real typos still merge.

nodes.label: _norm()/_norm_label()
nodes.rationale: Unicode-aware [\W_]+ regex with casefold() and NFKC normalization, because the ASCII-only version collapsed any non-ASCII label to an empty string and falsely merged them.

nodes.label: _make_id / _normalize_id
nodes.rationale: NFKC normalization before ID generation so composed/decomposed forms of the same character produce the same node ID; casefold() replaces lower() for correct Turkish/German/Greek folding; Unicode word chars preserved so non-ASCII identifiers are not collapsed to a bare file stem.

nodes.label: Node ID format spec ({parent_dir}_{stem}_{entity})
nodes.rationale: Directory-qualified stems prevent node ID collisions across same-named files in different directories, and a shared format keeps AST and semantic extractors from producing disconnected ghost-duplicate node pairs for the same file.

nodes.label: Leiden/Louvain community detection
nodes.rationale: Seeded (seed=42) with deterministically sorted input so community IDs are stable across parallel rebuilds, reducing JSON diff churn in multi-dev repos.

nodes.label: Deterministic community IDs
nodes.rationale: Assigned by a total order ((-size, sorted node IDs)) so an identical grouping always gets identical IDs across runs, rather than being numbered by the partitioner's non-seed-stable enumeration order.

nodes.label: remap_communities_to_previous
nodes.rationale: Greedy overlap remapper preserves existing IDs so hand-edited labels don't drift onto the wrong communities.

nodes.label: AST extractor (tree-sitter)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, LLM-free extraction path for code; code-only corpora skip the semantic pass entirely, which is reserved for docs, papers, images, and transcripts.

nodes.label: Semantic LLM extraction pass
nodes.rationale: Reserved for docs, papers, images, and transcripts; exits non-zero when all chunks fail so backend failures are not masked by a silent empty graph.

nodes.label: extract_files_direct()
nodes.rationale: backend=None now calls detect_backend() and raises a clear ValueError if no key is configured, instead of silently defaulting to kimi and sending the corpus to Moonshot AI.

nodes.label: detect_backend()
nodes.rationale: Places Ollama last so paid API keys take precedence over an ambient OLLAMA_BASE_URL; custom providers are auto-detected after built-ins.

nodes.label: Claude backend
nodes.rationale: Gained an anthropic optional extra so it is installable like every other backend; previously it was the only backend with no extra.

nodes.label: claude-cli backend
nodes.rationale: Handles all four documented hollow-response failure modes (empty stream, no JSON, missing result, empty result) so it no longer loops; prefers claude.cmd on Windows to avoid PATHEXT .ps1 resolution failure.

nodes.label: Kimi K2.6 backend
nodes.rationale: Thinking is disabled on Moonshot calls because reasoning mode consumed the entire token budget leaving content empty; temperature is skipped because the model enforces its own fixed value.

nodes.label: Ollama backend
nodes.rationale: num_ctx derived from actual chunk size instead of a hardcoded 131072, because over-allocating KV-cache slots for small chunks exhausted VRAM; OLLAMA_BASE_URL pointing at link-local or cloud-metadata addresses fails closed.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock backend
nodes.rationale: Credentials resolved via the standard AWS provider chain (AWS_PROFILE, AWS_REGION, IAM roles, SSO) rather than a graphify-specific key.

nodes.label: Adaptive retry bisection
nodes.rationale: Context-window-exceeded errors and hollow responses are rewritten to finish_reason=length so they route into exponential file-chunk bisection (up to 6 levels) instead of silently dropping the chunk.

nodes.label: _response_is_hollow()
nodes.rationale: Detects empty/null/whitespace content and parsed results with no nodes or edges.

nodes.label: hooks.py / git hook scripts
nodes.rationale: Validates that hook scripts live within the repo root to close a supply-chain vector where a malicious commit could redirect hook execution; _PINNED= uses single quotes to prevent shell injection from paths with metacharacters.

nodes.label: post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds detach via nohup & disown so git returns in ~100ms instead of blocking the commit for the full rebuild; skips rebuild when only graphify-out/ files were committed to avoid an infinite dirty-tree loop.

nodes.label: _rebuild_code
nodes.rationale: Per-repo fcntl.flock non-blocking lock prevents unbounded parallel rebuilds; lock-losers queue changed_paths to a pending file that the lock-holder drains and merges on acquire so no paths are dropped.

nodes.label: PreToolUse graph nudge hook
nodes.rationale: Extended from Bash search to Read|Glob because an agent answering a question by reading many source files natively slipped past the grep/rg/find-only nudge; never blocks, only nudges toward graphify query.

nodes.label: watch.py (--watch mode)
nodes.rationale: Mixed-batch commits rebuild code immediately AND set needs_update, because code changes were previously dropped when batched with non-code files.

nodes.label: SKILL.md (per-host skill file)
nodes.rationale: Split into a lean progressive-disclosure core (~615 lines, ~47% less always-loaded context) linking to an on-demand references/ sidecar, so a normal build loads no reference at all; installed atomically via temp-file + os.replace() to avoid half-installed empty skill directories.

nodes.label: references/ sidecar
nodes.rationale: On-demand reference slices (extraction-spec, query, update, exports, transcribe, github-and-merge, add-watch, hooks) read only when that path is actually taken.

nodes.label: tools/skillgen/
nodes.rationale: Single source generating all 15 skill bodies + sidecars, with CI guards (--check, --audit-coverage, --monolith-roundtrip, --always-on-roundtrip) proving references are byte-identical slices of the old monolith so nothing is lost.

nodes.label: skill-windows.md
nodes.rationale: Rewritten from PowerShell to bash because Claude Code on Windows uses git-bash, where PowerShell syntax caused exit code 49 failures.

nodes.label: Query logging (~/.cache/graphify-queries.log)
nodes.rationale: JSON Lines record per query; full subgraph responses are not stored by default, with GRAPHIFY_QUERY_LOG_DISABLE=1 to opt out and GRAPHIFY_QUERY_LOG_RESPONSES=1 to opt into response text.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion
nodes.rationale: Step 0 extracts actual graph vocab and forces the LLM to pick expansion tokens only from that set, preventing hallucinated expansions.

nodes.label: BFS/DFS hub-transit skipping
nodes.rationale: High-degree hubs (threshold max(50, p99_degree)) can be destinations but are not expanded as transit, because hub hops produce semantically meaningless 2-hop paths in Android/Spring corpora.

nodes.label: _search_tokens
nodes.rationale: Strips punctuation from search terms so a question like 'what calls extract?' matches the extract node.

nodes.label: Chinese query segmentation
nodes.rationale: Compound Chinese tokens split via jieba with a character bigram fallback; the original compound is preserved alongside segments for exact-match.

nodes.label: Obsidian export (to_obsidian/to_canvas)
nodes.rationale: Caps filenames on UTF-8 bytes rather than chars so multibyte/CJK labels are handled, with an 8-char hash suffix on truncation to keep distinct long-prefix labels from colliding.

nodes.label: Wiki export (to_wiki)
nodes.rationale: Fails fast with exit 1 when .graphify_analysis.json is missing and raises before the cleanup loop on empty communities — two safety layers against silently deleting existing wiki articles.

nodes.label: callflow-html export
nodes.rationale: Self-contained Mermaid architecture/call-flow page grouped by community; regenerates on every rebuild only if the file already exists — opt-in by existence, zero config.

nodes.label: Neo4j export
nodes.rationale: Cypher escaping strips C0 control chars and newlines; --password reads from NEO4J_PASSWORD env var by default rather than the command line.

nodes.label: God-node detection
nodes.rationale: Generic JSON key nodes are filtered because their degree is positional (every sibling record references them), not architectural; language built-in globals are filtered at resolution for the same reason.

nodes.label: Surprising Connections
nodes.rationale: Cross-language and code-to-doc INFERRED calls/uses edges are suppressed because label matching across language boundaries is resolver pollution and a symbol name in a README is documentation cross-reference noise, not structural insight.

nodes.label: Cross-language phantom edge filter
nodes.rationale: INFERRED calls edges whose endpoints belong to different language families are discarded at graph-build time, with an explicit anti-rule added to the skill prompt.

nodes.label: INFERRED to EXTRACTED call promotion
nodes.rationale: A cross-file call is promoted to EXTRACTED when the caller's file has an explicit imports/imports_from edge to the callee, because a top-of-file import proves the binding; on a 92-file CJS corpus this promoted 88% of cross-file calls.

nodes.label: Python AST extractor
nodes.rationale: decorated_definition treated as a transparent wrapper so @property/@staticmethod/@classmethod methods keep their class-qualified ID instead of becoming orphans.

nodes.label: JS/TS/TSX extractor
nodes.rationale: Scope guard restricts _js_extra_walk emission to program-level declarations so const/let inside arrow-function callbacks no longer emit phantom god-nodes; .tsx uses language_tsx so JSX nodes are not silently dropped.

nodes.label: Svelte extractor
nodes.rationale: Dedicated regex pass over <script> and template content because tree-sitter's JS parser silently dropped static imports and markup-level dynamic imports in .svelte files.

nodes.label: Dart extractor
nodes.rationale: Child node IDs switched to _make_id(_file_stem(path), name) so absolute paths are not embedded, consistent with every other extractor.

nodes.label: SQL extractor
nodes.rationale: Deterministic tree-sitter extraction of tables, views, procedures, FK references and FROM/JOIN reads_from edges with no LLM needed; regex fallback decodes UTF-8 to avoid non-ASCII identifier hash mismatches.

nodes.label: Terraform/HCL extractor
nodes.rationale: Node IDs are directory-scoped for cross-file resolution across a structured infrastructure dependency graph of resources, data sources, modules, variables, outputs, providers, and locals.

nodes.label: Markdown extractor
nodes.rationale: Fenced code blocks no longer emit orphan codeblock_N nodes because they carried only contains edges and no semantic meaning; the fence toggle is kept so inner content is not mis-parsed as headings.

nodes.label: MCP config extractor
nodes.rationale: Captures server nodes, package refs, and env var requirements while discarding env values to prevent secret leakage.

nodes.label: .NET project file extractor
nodes.rationale: XML parsing pre-screens for <!DOCTYPE>/<!ENTITY> before ET.fromstring to block billion-laughs DoS on malicious project files.

nodes.label: BYOND DreamMaker extractor
nodes.rationale: tree-sitter-dm moved to an optional extra because it ships only a Windows wheel and compiled from source on Linux/macOS, aborting the entire install when a C toolchain was missing.

nodes.label: Fortran extractor
nodes.rationale: Names lowercased for case-insensitive matching; the C-preprocessor step passes an absolute path and is blocked from #include exfiltration via -nostdinc -I /dev/null.

nodes.label: Pascal/Delphi extractor
nodes.rationale: Regex fallback covers unit/program/library headers, uses clauses, inheritance, method declarations and intra-file calls so extraction works without tree-sitter-pascal.

nodes.label: C/C++ extractor
nodes.rationale: #include paths resolved relative to the including file and used as the full target node ID, matching what extraction creates for the included file; previously all include edges dangled with a basename-only ID.

nodes.label: TypeScript type/heritage extraction
nodes.rationale: The walker only inspected class_heritage and the resolver only consulted the import table, so interface extends_type_clause and same-file class bases produced no inherits/implements edges; both gaps closed.

nodes.label: Type-reference edges
nodes.rationale: references edges tagged with parameter_type, return_type, generic_arg, field, and attribute contexts, with inheritance split into inherits (superclass) vs implements (protocol/interface/trait); dedup key includes context.

nodes.label: Cross-file call resolution
nodes.rationale: Skips any callee name matching 2+ candidates because there is no import evidence to pick the right target, and splits into case-sensitive vs case-insensitive label indexes (PHP only) since lowercasing both sides produced phantom edges.

nodes.label: Progressive-disclosure skill design
nodes.rationale: A lean always-loaded core plus on-demand references cuts always-loaded context ~47% while keeping the full default pipeline inline; aider and devin stay monolithic by design.

nodes.label: Deterministic graph output
nodes.rationale: Sorted traversal, sorted edges, fixed seeds and PYTHONHASHSEED=0 together make graph.json byte-for-byte reproducible so per-node diffs report real change rather than spurious churn.

nodes.label: SSRF / egress hardening
nodes.rationale: Link-local and cloud-metadata targets fail closed and non-http(s) base_urls are rejected, because a provider base_url is where the corpus and API key are sent; NAT64 addresses are exempted from the reserved-IP block to avoid false positives on IPv6-only networks.

nodes.label: Untrusted document screening
nodes.rationale: On-disk size cap plus a bounded streaming-decompression ceiling for docx/xlsx zip containers so a zip-bomb in a scanned corpus cannot exhaust memory.

nodes.label: Shrink guard (_check_shrink)
nodes.rationale: Refuses to overwrite when the new graph has fewer nodes, but is bypassed when changed_paths contains explicit deletions so stale nodes cannot accumulate indefinitely; --force and GRAPHIFY_FORCE=1 override it after legitimate refactors.

nodes.label: Stale node eviction
nodes.rationale: Reconciles the existing graph against current disk state and evicts any node whose source_file no longer exists, with _norm_source_file applied on both sides and .as_posix() paths so Windows separators do not defeat the match.

nodes.label: Codex platform integration
nodes.rationale: Writes an absolute path to the graphify executable to fix PATH resolution in the VS Code extension on Windows; hook-check exits silently to resolve additionalContext rejection on Codex Desktop PreToolUse.

nodes.label: Kilo Code platform integration
nodes.rationale: Existing .kilo/kilo.jsonc is read but never rewritten — plugin registration goes to kilo.json so user comments are preserved.

nodes.label: Antigravity platform integration
nodes.rationale: Rules file carries trigger: always_on frontmatter so Antigravity recognises it, and the workflow file needs name: graphify frontmatter to appear in the slash-command dropdown.

nodes.label: Amp platform integration
nodes.rationale: Installs to ~/.config/agents/skills/graphify and .agents/skills/graphify because Amp does not search the .amp/skills paths the earlier install used; stale directories are cleaned up on next run.

nodes.label: Kiro platform integration
nodes.rationale: Install now uses the shared helper instead of a bare write_text, which had bypassed the references/ sidecar and .graphify_version stamp.

nodes.label: Gemini CLI platform integration
nodes.rationale: BeforeTool hook uses a cross-platform python -c with json.dumps instead of bash-only test-and-echo, which failed on Windows CMD and Git Bash.

nodes.label: VS Code Copilot integration
nodes.rationale: Instructions rewritten to be prescriptive — the agent's first tool call must read GRAPH_REPORT.md, with an explicit trigger list and a narrow allowlist for raw source reads.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md templates
nodes.rationale: Strengthened with ALWAYS/NEVER/IF ... EXISTS graph-first directives, and _AGENTS_MD_SECTION includes the /graphify trigger so all AGENTS.md platforms invoke the skill tool.

nodes.label: Google Workspace export (gws)
nodes.rationale: Converts .gdoc/.gsheet/.gslides into Markdown sidecars before semantic extraction, with the account email pseudonymized via SHA256; gws runs from the sidecar output dir with a relative -o path to match its path validation.

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_OUT env var
nodes.rationale: Overrides the output directory so one graph can be shared across multiple git worktrees.

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_API_TIMEOUT env var
nodes.rationale: Now applies to the claude-cli subprocess and Anthropic SDK backend too, since both subprocess paths hardcoded timeout=600 and ignored the env var and --api-timeout flag.

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_OLLAMA_NUM_CTX env var
nodes.rationale: An invalid value falls through to the auto-derived value with a warning rather than the hardcoded 131072 that exhausted VRAM; a too-small value warns that Ollama will silently truncate the prompt.
